note: The cast of docs/STORY.md. 'skin' is one of ANHCharacter's bodies. 'from' is the story's name for where they live; 'stop' is the bus stop they are found beside, in the small level and in the real city alike (the stops already put the story's places on real ones: oshoja is Oshodi, marketsq is Tejuosho Market, eko is CMS); 'districts' are real districts to fall back on where a level lacks that stop. 'unlock': start | mission:<id> | mission:<id>+flag:<name> | story+flag:<name> | premium:<gold kobo> | never. Blockout rule: a character whose skin the project lacks plays as the first body it has.

characters.name: Tunde Adeyemi
characters.role: Danfo conductor. Quick mouth, quick feet, loyal, takes the hits.

characters.name: Amaka Nwosu
characters.role: Phone-repair and hacking genius. Sharp, funny, fearless.

characters.name: Chidi Nwosu
characters.role: Amaka's little brother, pulled into the Red Cowries.

characters.name: Baba Sule
characters.role: Femi's old partner and Tunde's mentor. He drives the bus Shina took.

characters.name: Zainab Yusuf-Cole
characters.role: Independent journalist chasing the Kingmaker's money.

characters.name: Sir Jaguar
characters.role: Head of the Red Cowries, a fictional campus confraternity turned street gang.

characters.name: Shina Garage
characters.role: Motor-park strongman. He runs the levies and owes favours upward.

characters.name: Kemi Lawson-Bright
characters.role: Island party promoter who knows everyone's secrets.

characters.name: Hon. Dapo "Kingmaker" Akinsola
characters.role: Fictional politician running for governor, and Shina's sponsor.

characters.name: Chief Barnabas "Big Bar" Okon
characters.role: The fictional Big Man who funds the Kingmaker from his Eko Crest tower.

languages.note: What each of the cast speaks in their lines. Yoruba lines carry their English in brackets; the made-up voices follow the Yoruba tone marks.
yoruba: Tunde (to his mother and the old men)
